name: concept-learning
description: Research-first Korean Java/Spring lessons with verified local sources and worldwide instructional image research; explain or summarize.

interface.shortDescription: Korean-first technical lessons, with global image research.
interface.longDescription: An early-career Java/Spring teaching plugin. Prefer Korean individual and Korean IT company engineering articles for the majority of explanatory reading; validate technical facts with original official references regardless of language. Search both Korean and English sources—including international official manuals, engineering blogs, and publicly available courses—for high-quality actual instructional images. Explain English image labels in Korean and verify relevance, readability, rights and actual display. Distinguishes deep Explain from concise Summarize. No automated publishing or runtime QA hooks.
capabilities: Prefer verified Korean developer and Korean IT-company technical articles for explanations, with official cross-checks
Search Korean and international technical sources for legible instructional images and explain labels in Korean
Explain backend mechanisms deeply or summarize core concepts concisely, with transparent evidence limitations
